title: osteospermum moniliferum subsp. canescens
intro: Osteospermum moniliferum subsp. canescens, commonly known as African Daisy, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Osteospermum moniliferum subsp. canescens include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
